rights.terms: Official public regulatory guidance; not authorization to re-identify or process personal data.
rights.permitted_destination: control requirements, citation, and synthetic tests

disposition.rationale: Supports separation of additional information, robust techniques, minimisation, and a prohibition on unauthorized re-identification.
disposition.contingency: Prefer anonymous or aggregate data; keep pseudonymous data within the restricted boundary.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Refresh on ICO update, technique change, threat change, or controller instruction.
